rows.text: Crrk crrk crrk... I'm getting a really terrifying vibe from up ahead. It's jet black with this pungent fishy death smell...
rows.speaker: Tremulous Nymph

rows.text: I can feel it... The warriors of Castrum Kremnos are locked in combat with that terrifying force behind the gates. One after the other, they fall down, and they get back up again...
rows.speaker: Tremulous Nymph

rows.text: I... I need to pluck up my courage, so I don't bring shame unto my master!
rows.speaker: Tremulous Nymph
